entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'representative' to speak with an agent.
Representative.
Connecting you now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return something. My VeloBand Pulse. It's just not tracking my heart rate correctly and I'm fed up with it.
I can certainly help you with that. I'm sorry to hear the Pulse isn't working out for you. Could I get your order number, please?
Yeah, hold on. It's VF789-0123.
Got it, thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse, delivered about 33 days ago. No problem at all.
Good. So how do I send it back?
Well, our standard policy gives you a full 90 days from the delivery date to make a return, so you have plenty of time. Don't worry, I can email you a return label right now.
Oh, 90 days? That's great. Yeah, please send the label.
Of course. I'm just initiating the return in our system now... one moment... Hmm. That's very odd. The system is giving me an error message.
An error? What kind of error? You just told me I had plenty of time.

I am so sorry. Let me check the fine print for this specific item. I am... oh, I see. I've made a mistake. It seems our electronic wearables, like the Pulse, have a 30-day return window, not 90. I am incredibly sorry, I gave you the wrong information.
You've got to be kidding me. It's been 33 days! I'm three days late because you told me the wrong policy! If I had known it was 30 days, I would have called last week. This is unacceptable.

You are absolutely right to be upset, and this is completely my error. I sincerely apologize for the misinformation. Since my mistake directly caused this issue, let me see what I can do to make this right.
You'd better. I don't want to be stuck with a $150 piece of junk.

I completely understand. While the system won't let me override the return window, what I can do for the major inconvenience and my mistake is offer you a $25 credit to your VeloFit account. You can use it on any future purchase. It's the maximum I'm authorized to offer, but I want to extend it as an apology.
A $25 credit doesn't help me with the faulty device I have right now. That's not a real solution.

I understand that. In addition to the credit, I can also connect you with our dedicated technical support team. They are experts with the VeloBand and can either resolve the tracking issue or, if they determine it's a manufacturer's defect, they can process a warranty replacement for you.
So... I get a $25 credit and you'll get someone to fix or replace it?
Exactly. We'll add the credit to your account for the trouble I've caused, and then I'll get you right over to a specialist who can help with the device itself. How does that sound?
Okay... fine. That's a fair solution. I appreciate you taking responsibility for the mistake. Let's do that.
Excellent. I've just applied the $25 credit to your account. Thank you for your patience and for allowing me to correct my error. I'm transferring you to our technical team now. Please hold.
Thank you, Alex.
